handoff: Changes requested: a red verify is lost when its receipt is refused because the story moved on (ready approved mid-run → merge, same head); lastVerify caches refused receipts, so merge never re-verifies. AC1-7 traced; suite green.

findings.title: A refused red verify receipt still fills the cache, so its failure is lost
findings.detail:
lastVerify takes the newest check receipt with `verify` from the unit's receipt files, whether or not apply accepted it. applyOne refuses any receipt whose step/attempt is not the cursor's (packages/core/src/apply.ts:226). story-approve does not wait for a running check lease. Repro: story parked at `ready` (shipped story/quick), base moves cleanly, decide orders verify.run with step `ready`. While it runs, the person runs `norn story approve`, so the cursor moves to `merge` and the head stays the same. The verify ends red and its receipt (step ready) is refused as stale. On the next tick, StoryFacts.verified equals {head, base}, so reverify (packages/core/src/decide/steps.ts:257) returns false and the story waits at `merge` with no update. This breaks AC5 'Given the verify run is red, then the story takes its waiting step's stale edge to update' and user story 55. It is a real gap, not a contrived edge: a merge step exists so a person can approve before the PR merges.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Cache only verify runs that were applied, or let a verify receipt apply at whichever step the story now waits at (a gate or merge park) when its head still matches. Another option is to have reverify ignore a pair whose receipt step/attempt is not the current cursor. Add an S1 test: verify ordered at ready, approve applied before its red receipt, then expect the stale route (or a new verify) at merge.

findings.title: A dead check-run leaks its temporary merged worktree
findings.detail:
Only the `finally` in runCheckOrder (line 183) and runCheck's not-started path remove the norn-verify- worktree. When `norn check-run` is killed, its lease goes dead and sweepCheckOrders unlinks the order without reading `order.verify`. The temp folder stays in `git worktree list` of the main checkout, and worktreePrune cannot drop it while the folder exists. Each crash leaves one more.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: In sweepCheckOrders, read the stale order and removeMergedTree(order.verify) before unlinking it.

findings.title: classify's doc comment now sits above verified()
findings.detail:
`verified` was put between `/** Tick-classified outcomes. ... */` and `classify`. That doc comment now attaches to the wrong function, and classify has none.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move verified() above the 'Tick-classified outcomes' comment.
